agents.what: Clear out the workings so the findings can be found
agents.why: Two hundred and eighteen research notes and a hundred scratch scripts have piled up. The risk is not disk space — it is someone paying again for an answer we already have, or quoting a figure that was true last week. The job is to sort what is a paid measurement's only record from what is genuinely spent, write an index of the first, and delete the second.
